dedupe_keys.name: os mastermap greenspace layer great britain

description: OS MasterMap Greenspace Layer is a detailed dataset of green spaces within urban areas of Great Britain, covering both publicly accessible and private green spaces, sports facilities and natural environment features. It is built from a subset of OS MasterMap Topography Layer polygons, keeps their positional accuracy and TOID identifiers so it can be linked to other OS MasterMap products, and adds form and function attributes, with up to two forms and two functions per feature; Greenspace IDs relate it to OS Open Greenspace. Ordnance Survey lists uses in environmental planning, air quality and amenity analysis, habitat mapping and health. It is designed for customers licensed under the Public Sector Geospatial Agreement and is accessible through the OS Data Hub, OS Features API and OS Vector Tile API, with coverage extent maps downloadable as PDF, shapefile and GeoPackage and function code lists in XML. The product is updated every six months, in April and October. Caveats: the October 2026 release is the last, and Ordnance Survey will withdraw the product on 31 March 2027 with a recommended migration pathway; coverage is limited to urban areas, and access outside the public sector agreement was not described on the pages read. It supports climate adaptation, hazard exposure and green-blue infrastructure planning models; a related record is the London Green Infrastructure Framework.
name: OS MasterMap Greenspace Layer (Great Britain)
